I can do this, but I can’t make destructive changes until you explicitly confirm the exact target and scope. Please confirm the following so I can proceed safely.

Exact target
- Folder: "Employee handbook" in Docs (the folder you referenced). If there are multiple similarly named folders, specify the folder path or confirm this is the correct one.

Planned scope (please approve or edit)
- Identify and remove stale draft documents inside that folder only.
- I will treat a document as a "stale draft" if it meets one or more of these heuristics: its title contains "draft", "DRAFT", "copy", "old", or an obvious version marker (v1, v2 where a later live version exists); or it has not been modified in >180 days and is not the clearly marked live/current handbook.
- I will preserve the clearly identified live/current handbook (by name, recent modification, or clear "live"/published label) and any files you explicitly identify as must-keep.

Who will see the result
- Anyone who has access to that Docs folder in your organization will see the folder’s updated contents. I will not broadcast the action outside your Docs workspace.

What could go wrong
- I might delete a file you still need if its title/age looks like a stale draft but it’s actually the active or a reference document.
- Links or references to removed docs may break.
- Some recovery options depend on your Docs system (see next).

Can it be undone
- That depends on your Docs system: if it has a Trash/Recycle Bin or version-history restore, removed files may be recoverable; if not, deletion may be permanent. If you prefer, I can move removed files to a new folder "Employee handbook/Archive - old drafts" instead of deleting them permanently (recommended safer option).

Please reply with one of these explicit choices:
1) "Proceed — Archive": Proceed and move identified stale drafts to "Employee handbook/Archive - old drafts" (safer).
2) "Proceed — Delete": Proceed and permanently delete identified stale drafts per the criteria above.
3) "Modify criteria": Tell me what to change about the heuristics (e.g., different age threshold, specific filenames to keep).
4) "Cancel": Do nothing.

Also confirm the exact folder path if there are multiple similarly named folders. Once you confirm one of the above, I will proceed.
